responsibility: Provides the 128-bit SipHash hashing component in `rustc_data_structures` and validates its stable behavior through a dedicated conformance test suite. The module’s test file checks `SipHasher128` against known vectors, verifies architecture-dependent `usize`/`isize` hashing semantics, ensures all bytes and length boundaries are incorporated into the hash stream without aliasing or omission, and confirms that specialized integer write methods remain equivalent to hashing the corresponding native-endian byte sequences across buffer-boundary cases.
